title: DO LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS WALK THEIR TALK? MEASURING THE GAP BETWEEN IMPLICIT ASSOCIATIONS, SELF-REPORT, AND BEHAVIORAL ALTRUISM
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measures secular altruism in Large Language Models across three dimensions: implicit pro-altruism bias (using an adapted Implicit Association Test), behavioral altruism (using a forced binary choice task), and explicit self-reported altruism (using a self-assessment scale).
